#+TITLE: Appearance

* Both slide
:PROPERTIES:
:ORGACLE_TEXT_SCALE: 2.0
:ORGACLE_BACKGROUND: red
:END:

A relative text scale and a background colour, both set.

* Plain slide

No appearance properties at all -- the slide that must look exactly
like the deck's default, even coming straight from "Both slide".

* Absolute slide
:PROPERTIES:
:ORGACLE_TEXT_SCALE: 600
:END:

An absolute height (in 1/10pt, matching `orgacle-text-scale' itself),
no background.

* Malformed slide
:PROPERTIES:
:ORGACLE_TEXT_SCALE: banana
:ORGACLE_BACKGROUND: not-a-real-colour
:END:

Both properties present but unusable -- neither should crash
navigation, and both should behave as if absent.
